description: This file defines the PHP class Goteo\'Library\Worth, which manages meritocracy levels, including retrieval, saving, and calculations related to merit levels within the Goteo project.

classes.name: Goteo\Library\Worth
classes.description: A class managing meritocracy levels, providing methods to get level names, retrieve data, save updates, and calculate thresholds.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the name of a meritocracy level given its ID, considering localization.

methods.name: getAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for managing a specific merit level by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all merit levels, optionally handling localization differences.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates merit level data into the database.

methods.name: abitmore
methods.description: Calculates the amount needed to reach the next merit level above the specified amount.

methods.name: reach
methods.description: Determines the merit level applicable to a given accumulated amount.
